vis_meshes_render_3d_meshes: render 3D meshes on top of a base image with configurable opacity and colors
vis_posed_meshes_of_objects_visualize_ob: visualize object meshes in specified poses with camera projection and color blending
write_text_on_image_overlay_text: overlay formatted text on an image at a specified location with custom color and font size
create_object_mask_generate_mask: generate a binary mask image from projected 3D object vertices onto a 2D canvas
vis_meshes_blend_foreground_background: blend rendered mesh foreground with a background image using configurable opacity weights
